topic.title: Split and Join Against Edit
topic.shortdesc: User A splits and joins blocks. User B edits text that crosses the boundaries A introduced or removed.

section.title: Overview
section.p: The Authentication Service validates user credentials.
It issues signed access tokens that expire after one hour. Clients must refresh the token before it expires.
Any instance can serve any request.

ul.li: The database schema is migrated to revision 42. The migration tool is shipped with the service.
Port 8443 is open for inbound TLS traffic.
